# Learnora

> Free educational lessons, worked examples, practice quizzes and printable worksheets for middle-school learners, with resources focused on Grades 6–8.

Learnora provides curriculum-neutral learning support across mathematics, English, science, AI literacy, computer science and financial literacy. Lesson pages include explanations and examples; many also include practice, quizzes and worksheets.

## Start here

- [Home](https://learnora-ab2.pages.dev/): Browse subjects and learning resources.
- [Mathematics](https://learnora-ab2.pages.dev/math/grade-6/): Grade 6–8 mathematics lessons and practice.
- [English](https://learnora-ab2.pages.dev/english/): Grammar, reading and writing resources.
- [Science](https://learnora-ab2.pages.dev/science/): Grade 7–8 science lessons.
- [Curriculum guides](https://learnora-ab2.pages.dev/curriculum/): Selected curriculum guides for international learners.

## Selected learning resources

- [Understanding Fractions](https://learnora-ab2.pages.dev/math/grade-6/understanding-fractions): Fraction concepts, visual examples and practice.
- [Coordinate Geometry](https://learnora-ab2.pages.dev/math/grade-7/coordinate-geometry): Ordered pairs, quadrants, plotting points and reflections.
- [Linear Equations and Inequalities](https://learnora-ab2.pages.dev/math/grade-8/linear-equations-and-inequalities): Multi-step equations and inequality models.
- [Parts of Speech](https://learnora-ab2.pages.dev/english/grade-6-8/parts-of-speech): Grammar categories and examples.
- [Weather, Climate and the Water Cycle](https://learnora-ab2.pages.dev/science/grade-7/weather-climate-water-cycle): Weather, climate and Earth's water cycle.
- [How AI Works](https://learnora-ab2.pages.dev/ai-literacy/how-ai-works): Data, patterns, training and predictions.
- [Python Basics](https://learnora-ab2.pages.dev/computer-science/python-basics): Variables, input, output and simple calculations.
- [Needs, Wants and Simple Budgets](https://learnora-ab2.pages.dev/financial-literacy/budgeting): Budgeting and spending choices.
